set.body:
Supporting track: Pitch. Owner task.

Acceptance
1. A date with the Vice-President, Research in the second half of January, after the 15 January target.
2. Two or three investigators who have seen a rehearsal and will write a short statement of interest, including at least one outside the owner's lab.
3. Whether to ask now for an interim mandate: no commitment to an external platform until the demonstration.
set.title: PITCH0: Book the date and line up two or three investigators
